Generate gamma-von Mises control steps with explicit area densities

Source: R/controls.R
generate_ssf_controls.Rd

All observed rows and their segment identifiers are retained. The target bearing is fixed at the step origin and shared by the case and controls. Controls are not filtered by a raster or spatial observation window. This implementation is for an untruncated gamma step proposal and a von Mises angular proposal. A pool can be nested by retaining alternative <= J.

Usage

generate_ssf_controls(observed, n_controls, proposal, seed = NULL)

Arguments

observed

One row per observed step, with ID, stratum, step, angle, previous_bearing and target_bearing. Bearings and angles are in radians.

n_controls

Positive integer number of controls per observed step.

proposal

Named numeric vector with gamma shape, gamma rate, angular mean_angle and angular concentration.

seed

Optional integer RNG seed, restored on exit.

Value

Validated ssf_data with area-density weights and alternative zero for the case, 1:n_controls for controls. Source row order is preserved.
